title: 高盛闪辉说透：别指望人民币快速升值，1.6%加4%才是吸引力
speaker: Hui Shan

segments.en: How should we be looking at the yuan right now? Because again, China's been making great efforts to say, hey, wait a minute, our currency is appreciating. Yeah. We're not, we don't have an undervalued currency.
segments.zh: 现在应该怎么看人民币？因为中国一直在努力说，等等，我们的货币在升值。是的，我们并没有被低估的货币。

segments.en: It's up 4% year to date against the US dollar, but even the IMF says it will stay undervalued until there is a comeback to the first question. Yeah. Meaningful stimulus. There's quite a bit of a debate, right?
segments.zh: 年初至今对美元升值4%，但连IMF也说，除非回到第一个问题——有意义的政策支持——否则仍会被低估。是的。这方面争议不小。

segments.en: Even last week, PBOC put out this article and defending its own effects management. We have been saying all along that don't count down China appreciating its currency rapidly. That's just not something China will do.
segments.zh: 就在上周，央行还发文为其汇率管理辩护。我们一直说，不要指望中国让人民币快速升值。这不是中国会做的事。

segments.en: They will do gradually what you said, 4% year to date, and that's okay. Why inflation is lower, much lower in China than elsewhere. So on a real effective exchange rate basis, you're not appreciating that much.
segments.zh: 他们会像你说的那样渐进推进，年初至今4%，这没问题。因为中国通胀更低，远低于其他地方。所以按实际有效汇率算，升值幅度并没有那么大。

segments.en: And R&B internationalization, right? If China wants foreigners to hold R&B assets, your 10 year yield is 1.6. How do you make your products more attractive to foreigners? If you set an expectation, I'm going to appreciate 4%.
segments.zh: 还有人民币国际化。如果中国想让外国人持有人民币资产，十年期收益率才1.6。怎么让产品对外国人更有吸引力？如果设定预期，我会升值4%。

segments.en: So on top of the 1.6, you get 4%, total return is still attractive. So for so many reasons, we think that this gradual pace of appreciation is likely to happen in the coming years.
segments.zh: 所以在1.6的基础上再加4%，总回报仍有吸引力。基于诸多原因，我们认为未来几年更可能呈现渐进升值节奏。
